name: mt-nomad-residence-permit
description: The Malta Nomad Residence Permit for non-EU nationals who live in Malta and keep working remotely for an employer or clients outside Malta: who the Nomad Residence Permits (Income Tax) Rules (S.L. 123.210) cover and exclude, the first twelve months free of tax on that work income and the flat rate after, the foreign-tax test that removes the duty to report, registration and returns, family members, and when the ordinary Income Tax Act applies instead. Triggers: "Malta digital nomad visa", "Malta nomad residence permit tax", "remote work Malta permit".
